# Project Monet

> Project Monet is a creator-led Instagram marketing agency for founders and businesses worldwide.

Project Monet can manage a B2B SaaS company Instagram account, its founder account, or both. AI SaaS is a priority subset; an authorized AI avatar is one possible production format, not a requirement.

## Offers and method

- Method: Funnel-First Growth System.
- Standard Management starts at $1,000/month. It is the controlled-management path and has no virality, follower, lead, sales, or revenue guarantee.
- Viral Mandate starts at $2,500/month, uses a qualified six-month organic Instagram performance structure, and requires more creative control inside approved guardrails.
- For eligible Viral Mandate accounts, the qualifying result and measurement rules are defined after baseline review in the signed engagement. If the qualifying result is not delivered and eligibility remains intact through the completed engagement, a 50% refund of collected Viral Mandate management fees applies under the signed terms.
- Primary actions: request a Free Instagram Audit or apply for Viral Mandate qualification through the shared one-question-at-a-time forms.

Founder and team creator results are not Project Monet client campaign results.

Contact: Use the Email Project Monet link in the website footer.

[Project Monet Websites](https://www.projectmonet.space)
